system.description:
A protective aura radiates from you, granting yourself and nearby allies within the burst a shield of Health Bar slots equal to your CHA Mod, each slot worth 2 points and absorbing all damage types. The shield can't be healed, and ends early if it's depleted or when the duration expires.

Note: this system's Shield mechanic only ever sizes itself from the casting actor's own active toggled Spell, so a shield granted to OTHER actors isn't automated - track each affected ally's temporary pool manually.

upgrades.description: Each shield slot is worth 4 points instead of 2.
The burst radius increases by 5ft, and each shield slot is worth 6 points.
The burst radius increases by another 5ft, and each shield slot is worth 8 points.
